pages.seoDescription: Who Ledger & Co. is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: A friendly, sunlit workspace with a laptop, a coffee and a small stack of paperwork

children: We started Ledger & Co. because we kept meeting small-business owners who were brilliant at their craft and completely underwater on their books — not because they weren’t smart, but because nobody ever made the money side feel human.

So that’s what we do. We handle the bookkeeping, payroll and taxes, and we explain it all in plain English. You get your evenings back, your numbers make sense, and tax season stops being something to fear.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: You’ll work with the same friendly team who knows your business — not a call center and never a different stranger each month.
Your books live online, always current, always accessible. Check in whenever you like, or leave it to us — either way it’s handled.
Flat monthly plans, spelled out before you commit. Ask us anything without watching a clock — questions are part of the service.
